text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to designate the northerly westbound lane on Densley Avenue, between Keele Street and a point 30.5 metres east, for westbound right-turns only. It is appropriate to install an exclusive westbound right turn lane based on the existing lane configuration and our observations.
Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Designated the northerly westbound lane on Densley Avenue, between Keele Street and a point 30.5 metres east, for westbound right-turns only.
